description: Run a composite "full" wellcheck across dashboards and data models.

dashboards.description: One or more dashboard references to analyze. Each reference can be: - a Sisense dashboard ID, or - a dashboard title (name). At runtime this parameter is tolerant of a single string and will normalize it to a one-element list.

datamodels.description: One or more data model references to analyze. Each reference can be: - a data model ID, or - a data model title (name). At runtime this parameter is tolerant of a single string and will normalize it to a one-element list.

max_pivot_fields.description: Threshold used by the pivot-fields check. Any pivot widget with more than this number of fields is flagged.

examples.user_query: Run a full wellcheck on the 'Sales Dashboard' and 'Marketing Dashboard' to identify issues.
examples.notes: This call analyzes two dashboards for structural and widget-related issues, flagging pivot widgets with more than 5 fields.

examples.user_query: Check the 'Customer Data Model' for unused columns and other issues.
examples.notes: This call focuses exclusively on the 'Customer Data Model' to identify issues like unused columns, island tables, and other data model-specific checks.

examples.user_query: Analyze the 'Finance Dashboard' and 'HR Dashboard' along with the 'Employee Data Model' for comprehensive wellcheck results.
examples.notes: This call performs a full wellcheck across two dashboards and one data model, flagging pivot widgets with more than 10 fields and identifying structural issues in the data model.
